hints.title: Remainder Complements
hints.text: A sum of two numbers is divisible by k if their remainders modulo k sum to k, or if both remainders are 0.

hints.title: Frequency Array of Remainders
hints.text: Compute (x % k + k) % k for every element and count remainder frequencies in a table of size k.

hints.title: Pair Matching Check
hints.text: Verify that remainder 0 has even frequency, and for every i from 1 to k - 1, remainder i has the same frequency as remainder k - i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) pairings is quadratic and exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting remainder frequencies takes O(N) time and O(K) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles negative numbers properly using non-negative modulo formulas.
